Instead of shoveling cash into climate virtue signals, fund active forest management, firebreaks, and tech to detect outbreaks early. Canada’s mismanagement is a problem, but so is Washington’s refusal to lead by example.

Taxpayers fund both sides of this disaster—time to demand real solutions, not more cross-border finger-pointing.
